note: Page-time budgets in milliseconds, as the median on the seeded four-times project (make perf-budget). The final budgets are 300 ms per page and 100 ms for the frame share, with no margin. The frame budget applies to the largest frame value across the pages; a page that reads the project session list before its layout does shows a frame of about 0 ms, because the layout takes the shared answer, so that page is held by its own budget. Each page also has a fragment entry, "<page> fragment": the page asked for as a click on a link between two pages of the project asks (ADR 0064), at 300 ms with no frame share.
